text: Added calculateReconstructionError() detect --distribution anomalies using cell-type-specific PCA reconstruction errors. Replaced 4 general-purpose vignettes 4 vignettes built around package’s manuscript: introduction simulated ground-truth example, benchmark detectAnomaly()/calculateReconstructionError() known ground truth Zeisel brain dataset, two case studies (COVID-19 PBMC scRNA-seq MERFISH spatial colitis data) walking project/detect/characterize diagnostic workflow. Added new example datasets (zeisel_reference_data, zeisel_query_data, zeisel_benchmark_results, covid_reference_data, covid_query_data, merfish_reference_data, merfish_query_data) supporting new vignettes. Added plot.calculateReconstructionErrorObject() featuring robust visualization options (violin, boxplot, ridge, ComplexHeatmap). Upgraded detectAnomaly() resolve curse dimensionality allowing Isolation Forests run union query reference Highly Variable Genes (via n_hvgs) pc_subset = NULL. Improved anomaly detection switching default thresholding dynamic, data-driven Median Absolute Deviation method (threshold_method = "MAD", mad_multiplier = 2) across relevant functions.
